# Raw HTML Tags and SVG Fixture

Standard HTML tags:
<b>Bold HTML tag</b> and <i>Italic HTML tag</i>.

Custom unknown XML tags in prose:
<path fill="#000000"> and <vector android:name="test">.

HTML block:
<div class="custom-card">
  <span>Card Content</span>
</div>

SVG element:
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24">
  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
</svg>
